title: Umuhigo w'Umwana Ataravuka .
intro: Umutima w’ukuri warasezeranye umuhango mweranda imbere y’uko umwana ashika. Inkuru y’ico gishushanyo ibera mu bihome vy’ahantu heranda, aho ukwihebera Imana guhura n’ukwemerwa n’Imana. Uwo musuku wa Allah ni nde?
clues: Nari uwo mu muryango wubahwa muri Korowani.
Narahiye cane ko nzotanga umwana wanje ataravuka ngo akore igikorwa ca Allah.
Maze kuvyara, naratangaye kubona ari umukobwa, naho nari niteze umuhungu.
Umwana wanje namwise Mariyamu, izina ryerekana ukwihebera Imana n’ugukorera Imana.
Narondeye uburinzi bwa Allah ku mwana wanje n’abamukomotse kuri Shetani yavumwe.
Umwana wanje yaremewe n’Umukama, amushira mu minwe y’Umuhanuzi Zakariya mu rusengero.

location.label: Ikintu nyamukuru
options: Aho hantu heranda (mihrab) aho umwana wiwe yashirwa .
location.answer: Aho hantu heranda (mihrab) aho umwana wiwe yashirwa .

outcome.label: Ingaruka
options: Umwana wiwe yaremewe, ashirwa mu minwe ya Nkurunziza Zakariya .
outcome.answer: Umwana wiwe yaremewe, ashirwa mu minwe ya Nkurunziza Zakariya .

arabic: إِذْ قَالَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُ عِمْرَٰنَ رَبِّ إِنِّى نَذَرْتُ لَكَ مَا فِى بَطْنِى مُحَرَّرًۭا فَتَقَبَّلْ مِنِّىٓ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verse: [Mention, O Muḥammad], when the wife of ʿImrān said, "My Lord, indeed I have pledged to You what is in my womb, consecrated [for Your service], so accept this from me. Indeed, You are the Hearing, the Knowing." (3:35)
